patterns.name: Interralis evidence module
patterns.capability: evidence capture, projection, labeling, and privacy handling

module_plan_template.reason: Generated from the approved Interralis evidence-module paved road: keep types, collection, projection, labels, and privacy responsibilities split, with side effects isolated in collection.

assertions: types, project, labels, and privacy modules contain no filesystem, process, network, env, db, or shell side effects
collect is the only module that may use filesystem or process capabilities
the module facade re-exports focused public APIs and does not own collection, projection, labeling, or privacy logic
all five responsibility files exist under the module root

exemplar_structure.responsibility: Re-export the public discovery and registry surface while keeping logic out of the facade
Inventory local harness metadata sources through the filesystem shell
Define source registry records, source formats, and default patterns
Infer stable harness identities from paths and registry rules
Classify source formats and metadata-directory labels
Normalize harness identifiers and path components
Assert facade purity, dependency direction, pure-core side-effect bans, and shell isolation

patterns.allowed_departure: A task may rename roles or add files only when the brief carries pattern_deviation_reason explaining which invariant still proves pure/impure separation, privacy handling, and architecture-test coverage.

registration.approval_record: Human approval is recorded by adding the pattern entry and reviewer-approved exemplar commit in this registry.
steps: Add one pattern object to skills/paved-road-registry/patterns.json with an approved merged exemplar commit.
Run bin/adlc paved-road-patterns --pattern-id <id> --json to confirm the registry payload.
Update the paved-road-registry skill when the new pattern needs non-obvious matching or departure guidance.
